title: LIVE SOLAR RADIATION
source_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km surface analysis, DSWRF (downward short-wave radiation flux), hourly cycles
variable: DSWRF surface analysis step (hourly-averaged downward shortwave flux for the analysis hour)
temporal: hourly-averaged flux for the analysis hour (not instantaneous, not daily accumulation)
what: Surface downward shortwave solar radiation flux: solar power arriving at the surface, hourly-averaged for the model analysis hour. Nighttime reads zero (valid data, deep blue) — not missing data. Clouds reduce values quantitatively versus clear sky.
why_extreme: Rare peak midday clear-sky values compress into red-violet/deep-purple; ordinary day/night conditions own most of the color resolution.
